summary: # Overview of New Features in Marvelous Designer 12.2 ## Automatic UV Filling Tool The selected UV case can be automatically filled to the designated position. Go to the UV editor window to check and click on the new UV filling tool. In the dialogue window, the filling direction is set to the interval between the UV cases, and the filling ratio is set to the percentage of the area occupied by the UV case. This calculation is based on the UV map you have chosen. ### High-Select Rotation High-select rotation will allow the UV case to rotate according to the settings. You can also fix the resolution ratio and the ratio of the UV cases selected at the time of selection. Click on the application to check the effect after filling. Additionally, you can fill the UV case to other UV frames by selecting all UV cases of the COS version and changing to the selected frame option before clicking on the application to fill. ## Multi-Character Scene Production Marvelous Designer 12.2 allows you to insert or export multiple virtual models in the FBX format simultaneously. This capability will help you better complete multi-character scene production without being limited to a single character. When you need to add additional virtual models to the scene, please confirm the download type as an addition. ### Controlling Multiple Models Under the move option, you can set the vertical axis to move 2 meters, allowing for the control of two models. Open the animation editor window to check the virtual model animation. When you add a costume to the scene, you can also set the movement value for it to match the virtual model. Open the simulation and record the animation to check the final result. ## FBX Export Options Through the FBX format, you can choose to export all virtual models or some specific virtual models. The roll-up function allows you to simplify the opening position of the costume, such as the sleeve, pants, and so on. Use the edit version tool to select the outline of the 2D version, such as the sleeve line. Click on the right button to select the roll-up in the pop-up menu. ### Customizing Roll-Ups You can set the number of rolls up to three times and choose the length of each roll-up, with a minimum of 10 mm and a maximum of 200 mm. To facilitate checking the position after rolling up, the costume in the 3D window will appear. Click on the application to apply the input value and roll up the costume. Open the simulation to get the natural simulation effect. ## Asymmetrical Roll-Ups Currently, the roll-up function does not support symmetrical or continuous modification. However, when you use this function again, it will automatically utilize the data from the previous time. If you need to create an asymmetrical effect, you can manually modify the value. After clicking on the application, the roll-up window will still be running, allowing you to choose whether to reset the roll-up position according to your needs, returning it to the original shape of the costume. ### Managing Roll-Up Selections After resetting, you can set the value according to your needs and apply the roll-up again. Selecting the roll-up function will require you to choose the roll-up with all the roll-ups with the selected roll-up. In this example, we have deleted the roll-up between the left sleeve part and the body. When selecting a roll-up in the 2D or 3D window, go to the main menu and edit the roll-up with all the roll-ups. ## Advanced Selection Techniques At this time, all the roll-ups directly or indirectly associated with this roll-up will be selected together, allowing you to move them as a group. When using the adjustment roll-up tool in the 2D or 3D window, you can use the move tool to double-click a roll-up, thereby selecting all the roll-ups with the selected roll-up. By pressing the Shift key for multiple selections and double-clicking a roll-up, you will also select all the roll-ups with the selected roll-up. ### Limitations and Workarounds Please note that the items of the chain, side, button, inner shape, and roll-up roll-up cannot be selected through the option of selecting all the roll-ups with the selected roll-up. However, by connecting the roll-up to the roll-up with the pull-up function, you can select them all through this function. ## USD File Support The USD file is now supported with a unified UV coordinate. When you export the USD file, you can find and select a unified UV coordinate in the pop-up window. After selecting this option, you can set the pixels of the UV sticker. Additionally, select the fill-in-primitive border to extend it along the primitive border. After completion, select Confirm. ### Integration with Other Software This option is also applicable to the NVIDIA Omniverse Connector and can be imported into Adobe Photoshop via the Omniverse Connector Live Link. This integration is more stable than SubstancePaint.
